messages:
lee: FYI onboarding call with a customer hit a weird edge: ruby sampleapp inside our corporate container keeps getting 401s when the metadata server is slow. Streams disconnect after token refresh. Go/Node clients we tried keep the stream alive. Anyone seen stream re-auth behave differently in the Ruby gem?

tara: which sampleapp tag and gem version? streaming vs non-stream? :mag: 

lee: sampleapp@main, gem 0.11.0-rc2 local build. Using instance metadata provider (no static API key). Repro steps (minimal):
```
# on host
docker build -t ruby-sampleapp .
docker run --network=host -e REDWOOD_USE_METADATA=1 ruby-sampleapp
# then block metadata for 2s windows to simulate slow KMS
```
Logs look like: 
```
I, [2025-01-10T15:22:01.001Z]  INFO -- : starting stream to /v1/chat/stream
W, [2025-01-10T15:22:10.200Z]  WARN -- : 401 Unauthorized (token expired)
D, [2025-01-10T15:22:10.201Z] DEBUG -- : performing token refresh (provider)
D, [2025-01-10T15:22:12.600Z] DEBUG -- : refresh finished, reopening request? false
E, [2025-01-10T15:22:12.601Z] ERROR -- : stream closed: Unauthorized
```
Seems the client doesn't attempt to reopen the streaming connection after refresh.

oscar: we intentionally tightened retry defaults for non-idempotent streaming in 0.11 to reduce duplicate generations. Looks like that had an unintended side-effect for refreshable-token flows. Thanks for the repro @lee.

tara: quick workaround for customers: set REDWOOD_RETRY_OVERRIDE="max_attempts=5,auth_refresh_attempts=3" or pass explicit RetryOptions when constructing the client. Not great but buys time.

lee: posted a small docker-compose test and a hitless script in issue #9876. Will paste link in a sec.

oscar: I'll open a PR to: (1) add a small option auth_refresh_attempts defaulting to 2 for streams, (2) update the sampleapp README with a troubleshooting section for metadata latency, and (3) add an integration test that runs a fake metadata server which sleeps during token fetch.

tara: strongly 👍 on the README troubleshooting snippet. Could you also add a dev env var to force token-provider latency so we can run CI deterministic tests? e.g., REDWOOD_FAKE_TOKEN_DELAY=1500ms.

ioscar: good call. I'll add REDWOOD_FAKE_TOKEN_DELAY and a test that sets it. PR will be oscar/stream-auth-refresh-fix.

ci-bot: CI queued: branch oscar/stream-auth-refresh-fix (ruby-matrix). Integration job 'stream-refresh' scheduled.

oscar: pinging for quick reviewers: @tara @lee. This is a small change but affects SDK behavior so want 2 approvals. Cutting a CHANGELOG note too.

tara: I'll review this afternoon. If small, can merge after CI green. Also please add a short unit test for the RetryOptions parsing when set via env.

lee: thanks — once merged I'll verify with customer and update the onboarding doc we share during trials.

ci-bot: Integration job started: stream-refresh (timeout 10m). Logs: https://ci.internal/98765

oscar: thanks everyone. I'll include the dug-in repro in the PR description and link the issue for traceability.
